# Inspection Statuses

Inspection statuses report the result of each inspected day per project, data source and dataset. Authentication, pagination and errors are described in the [Overview](index.md).

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/inspection-statuses/data-sets` | [Get data set inspection statuses](#get-data-set-inspection-statuses) |
| `GET` | `/v1/inspection-statuses/data-sources` | [Get data source inspection statuses](#get-data-source-inspection-statuses) |
| `GET` | `/v1/inspection-statuses/projects` | [Get project inspection statuses](#get-project-inspection-statuses) |

---

## Get data set inspection statuses {: #get-data-set-inspection-statuses }

```http
GET /v1/inspection-statuses/data-sets
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data_source_id` | query | integer | Yes | Filter by data source ID |
| `dataset_id` | query | integer | No | Filter by data set ID |
| `start_date` | query | string | Yes | Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date` | query | string | Yes | End date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `data_volume_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by data volume status |
| `data_anomaly_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by data anomaly status |
| `data_validation_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by data validation status |
| `data_analytics_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by data analytics status |
| `inspection_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by inspection status |
| `limit` | query | integer | No | Maximum number of rows to return (default: 200, max: 5000) |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Get data set inspection statuses | array of [DatasetInspectionStatus](#datasetinspectionstatus) |
| `400` | Invalid limit | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/inspection-statuses/data-sets?data_source_id=<data_source_id>&start_date=<start_date>&end_date=<end_date>' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```

## Get data source inspection statuses {: #get-data-source-inspection-statuses }

```http

```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | query | integer | No | Filter by project ID |

| `data_source_name_like` | query | string | No | Filter by data source name |
| `is_inspected` | query | boolean | No | Filter by inspected state |
| `data_anomaly_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by data anomaly status |
| `data_volume_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by data volume status |
| `data_validation_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by data validation status |
| `data_analytics_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by data analytics status |
| `inspection_status` | query | integer | No | Filter by inspection status |

**Responses**

| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**
